page.layout: One block of verse in the centre of the page, one printed page. Margin note right beside the verse (three lines, in black letter). Catchword "Culmina" at the lower right below the last line.

p.i: Quin etiam nota visuntur imaginis umbra,
Post obitum maneis Parca redire facit,
In cameris etiam chorea peraguntur inanes,
Nulla licet nubes axe minetur aquam.
Sulphur ab ambrarum cathedris afflatur, & aura,
Nemo queat fixas ut removere loco.
Tartara si dubites hic volvere talia prasto,
Hic tibi Ruranæ Tartara vallis erunt.
Dum non rite pilis videantur ducere nomen,
Rectius hæc Rura nomina vallis habet.
Tecta latent, tecti monstrat arena pedem.
Cella patet prabens aditum diversa latebris,
Tractibus hæc etiam Damone plena iacent.
Monte canes degunt furvi terrore colonos
Ponte sub oblonge Rura sed arctar aquas.
Deserit ad lævam salebrosi fragmina montis,
Turris adhuc quadrata situ munita repâglis
Surgit, adhuc tecti signa videre licet.
Amnis ad Hatnegi mœnia pene ruit.

page.notes: Marginal note in black letter: "non Rotwenthal / sed Rurenthall." Lines of verse are printed as separate lines; the stanza breaks are approximate. Some words in the lower half are faint and uncertain. The running head is printed in spaced capitals.
